Subject: Level-change submission: docs, conflict checks, and committee slotting

Team —

We have one level-change packet that needs committee review in the next window. Quick runbook to keep this tight:

- Manager write-up due: Tue Mar 23 EOD (use the attached template).
- Conflict-of-interest checks: please flag any reviewers who need to recuse by EOD Fri Mar 19.
- Committee week we're targeting: Mon Mar 29 — Wed Mar 31; if conflicts push it, we should consider Apr 1 as an alternate.

Action items for you:
- Laura: can you confirm you can submit the manager write-up (redacted per the checklist) by Tue 3/23?
- Marcus: will you chair the packet review if schedule permits?
- Lauren: share availability so we can lock a slot and I can send the invite.
- Aditya: please run the reviewer conflict check against the candidate's 1:1/mentorship logs and let us know any close relationships (mentorship, dotted-line, IC mentorship) that should disqualify a reviewer.

Template and checklist are attached and I've linked a draft folder where the packet should live. HR (cc'ing People Ops contact separately) will receive the final packet once reviewers are confirmed.

Attachments: level_change_template.docx

Thanks — I want this to be efficient and low-friction; keep notes about any sensitive feedback so HR can redact before committee.

—Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering — Model Serving
Redwood Inference

Vivek —

I'll take the write-up. I have a draft but need clarification on how to handle sensitive peer feedback that references a personnel issue from last year. Do you want full verbatim in the packet or should I redact and summarize? If HR wants to handle redaction, I can drop the verbatim into a "sensitive" doc in the folder and a redacted summary into the packet.

I attached my draft (sachin_writeup_draft.docx) — it's manager-focused (contributions, impact, leadership examples) but includes a short section labeled "peer concerns". If we want HR to do the redaction, ping People Ops to accept the packet as confidential.

I'll aim to have the manager packet in the Drive folder by Mon 3/22 EOD if that timeline works.

Laura Bennett

If Lauren is a reviewer we should either document the mentorship publicly in the packet or move to an alternate reviewer to avoid recusal issues during scoring—I expect a pretty close call.

Proposed mitigation:
- Run a conflict recusal: if Lauren recuses, propose Ben Carter as alternate reviewer.
- Move the committee slot to Thu Apr 1 10:00 AM PT if we need to accommodate recusal and HR availability.

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Summary & final routing:

- Manager packet: Laura to submit final manager write-up into Drive by Mon 3/22 EOD (Laura confirmed).
- Reviewers: Marcus to chair; Laura will remain as manager contributor but recuse from scoring if she feels the mentorship bias applies. Ben Carter added as alternate reviewer and will be on the invite.
- Committee time: Thu Apr 1, 2026 10:00 AM PT — locking that slot. I'll send the invite (committee_invite_20260401.ics attached).
- HR: Sarah at People Ops (bcc'd) — please accept the packet as confidential. We will place the unredacted peer notes in the folder labelled "sensitive/" and a redacted summary in the main packet.

Please:
- Marcus: confirm you can chair Apr 1 10:00 AM PT.
- Ben: accept calendar invite and I'll loop you into the Drive folder.
- Aditya: post this thread can you confirm there are no other reviewer conflicts in the last 18 months?

Links & attachments: committee invite, manager write-up (when uploaded), redaction checklist.

If no objections by EOD Wed 3/24 I'll consider this final and instruct People Ops to schedule the confidential review packet with the committee.
